persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left behind the low wall, phone raised, turned three-quarters toward the camera, excited

persos.desc: woman in her 40s, amber-and-ivory boubou, arms crossed
persos.pose: standing in the middle in her own courtyard, arms crossed, calm

persos.desc: husband in his 40s, ruby-and-sunflower polo shirt, round belly, holding ONE single empty plate
persos.pose: standing on the right by the neighbor's gate, holding the plate, embarrassed

dialogue: Mes abonnés, la voisine chasse encore un homme dêh !
Ma sœur, c'est ton mari. Il mange chez moi chaque soir.
Ta sauce m'a chassé d'abord, chérie.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The gossip films excitedly, whispering loudly to her phone. The neighbor answers calmly, pointing her chin at the man with the plate. The husband lifts the empty plate slightly and says the last line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The gossip freezes, phone still raised, her excited smile melting. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the gossip wife's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LES ABONNÉS EN ATTENDANT LA SUITE :
mecanisme: arroseuse arrosée + relance assassine du mari
